name: Ottsel
game: Jak and Daxter: The Precursor Legacy (PS2)
notes: Ottsel owns its recipe (ottsel-v...-padmint.json in each release). Apple Silicon Mac only; the disc must be the USA SCUS-97124 Black Label release, which the build checks.

commands: brew install cmake ninja ripgrep glslang spirv-cross

steps: First time only: copy the Ottsel game data folder from {folder} to the iPhone or iPad (iCloud Drive, a USB drive, or Finder: select the device, open Files and drag it onto Ottsel). In Ottsel, open ••• → Game Data → Import Game Data…, choose that folder, then close and reopen Ottsel.
Unzip {file}, move Ottsel to your Applications folder and open it. It needs no Apple account.
First time only: in the menu bar, choose Game Data → Import Game Data…, pick the Ottsel game data folder in {folder}, then quit and reopen Ottsel.
